title: A Game of Throngs: How Spotlight Tourism Reshapes Local Economies
abstract: arXiv:2611.21364v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In July 2017, San Juan de Gaztelugatxe, a modest chapel in the Basque Country, appeared as "Dragonstone" in Game of Thrones, transforming a locally known site with limited tourism activity into a global tourist destination overnight. We exploit this exogenous spotlight shock to estimate its causal effects on the local economy using a novel administrative dataset and a Synthetic Control approach. We find an abrupt increase in tourism activity, far exceeding the effects documented in the literature. Despite this surge, employment gains in tourism-related sectors were largely offset by losses elsewhere, resulting in no net effect on total employment. We also document signs of housing-market overheating, with increases in both property transactions and prices. We find no evidence that the shock displaced the local population. translated_title: 《人潮之戏：聚光灯旅游如何重塑地方经济》
translated_abstract: 2017年7月，位于西班牙巴斯克地区的一座不起眼小教堂San Juan de Gaztelugatxe在《权力的游戏》中以“龙石岛”的形象亮相，使这个原本仅有本地人知晓、旅游活动有限的景点一夜之间成为全球旅游目的地。我们利用这一外生的“聚光灯”冲击，基于一份新颖的行政数据集和合成控制法，估计其对当地经济的因果效应。研究发现，旅游活动出现骤然激增，其幅度远超文献中已记录的效应。尽管如此，旅游相关行业的就业增长在很大程度上被其他行业的就业损失所抵消，导致总就业人数没有净变化。我们还发现了房地产市场过热的迹象，房产交易量和价格均有所上涨。我们没有发现该冲击造成当地人口流出的证据；相反，来自海外的游客数量增加了约一倍。综合来看，这些发现表明……
tldr: 《权力的游戏》取景带来的“聚光灯”冲击使当地旅游活动激增、房价上涨、外国游客翻倍，但就业增长被其他行业损失抵消，总就业未见净改善。
en_tdlr: The Game of Thrones "spotlight shock" caused a dramatic surge in tourism, housing prices, and foreign arrivals, but employment gains were offset elsewhere, yielding no net employment effect on the local economy.
